answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond from a scarce, independently verified resource, then slash it when two identities are proven to share control or coordinate a prohibited claim. For example, a glacier-data inlet market could accept reports only from bonded agents and use audits against sensor readings; a willow-themed identity earns no extra trust. Spinning up a thousand names now means locking up a thousand bonds and risking them all, so Sybil attacks become costly rather than merely easy to rename.
